assessments.title: Individual computer-based programming exam
assessments.description: Three hours, in person, without Internet or AI. Choose one slot in 14–18 December 2026 or 4–11 January 2027; no personal slot is recorded here. Complete ProgGame before signing up, by 9 December at 16:00. Bronze unlocks grades up to D, silver up to B, gold up to A; exam performance determines the grade. A requires at least one bronze, one silver, and one gold task passed.

assessments.title: Individual AI-assisted mini project
assessments.description: Pass/fail. Proposal due 27 November at 16:00. Present at the R1 reactor hall EXPO on 10 December in an assigned two-hour slot; the personal slot is not yet recorded. Follow the course rules for individual implementation, regular Git commits, and prompts in commit messages.
